default.question: How do I create an account?
default.answer: Visit our login page and click 'Sign Up'. Fill in your email address, create a password, and provide your profile information. You'll receive a confirmation email to verify your account.

default.question: How do I find chat rooms?
default.answer: From the home page, you can browse public rooms or use the search feature to find specific topics. You can also join rooms recommended based on your interests.

default.question: What is the difference between public and private rooms?
default.answer: Public rooms are open to everyone and appear in search results. Private rooms require an invitation or approval from the room owner to join.

default.question: Can I send files and media in chat rooms?
default.answer: Yes, you can share images, videos, documents, and other files in both group chats and direct messages. Simply click the attachment button and select your file.

default.question: How do I pin important messages?
default.answer: In any chat room, hover over a message and click the menu icon. Select 'Pin Message' to pin it to the top of the room. Only room moderators can pin/unpin messages.

default.question: What are reactions?
default.answer: Reactions let you quickly respond to messages with emojis. Hover over any message and click the emoji icon to add a reaction. This is a non-intrusive way to acknowledge messages.

default.question: How do I create my own room?
default.answer: Click the 'Create Room' button on the home page. Fill in your room name, description, select privacy settings, and configure optional features like password protection.

default.question: How do I manage room members?
default.answer: Room owners can access member management through the room settings. You can approve pending members, assign roles, kick users, or ban problematic members.

default.question: Can I delete messages in my room?
default.answer: Room moderators can delete any message in the room. Regular members can only delete their own messages within a limited time after posting.

default.question: Is my chat history encrypted?
default.answer: Yes, all messages are encrypted in transit using SSL/TLS encryption. We also encrypt stored data to protect your privacy and security.

default.question: Can I block a user?
default.answer: Yes, you can block users from their profile or your inbox. Blocked users cannot send you direct messages or see your status.

default.question: How do I report inappropriate content?
default.answer: Use the report button on any message or user profile. Our moderation team reviews reports and takes appropriate action, including removing content or banning users.

default.question: How do I start a direct message with someone?
default.answer: Click the 'Inbox' button and start a new conversation, or visit someone's profile and click the message icon. Your conversations are private and only visible to both of you.

default.question: Can I make video or audio calls?
default.answer: Yes, you can initiate video or audio calls from your inbox or someone's profile. Both users must accept the call request to connect.

default.question: What is Random Chat?
default.answer: Random Chat connects you with random strangers for 1-to-1 video conversations, similar to Omegle. You can text and video chat with each new connection.

default.question: How do I change my profile picture?
default.answer: Go to your profile settings and click on your avatar. Upload a new image from your device. Changes are saved automatically.

default.question: Can I delete my account?
default.answer: Yes, you can permanently delete your account from the 'Danger Zone' section in profile settings. This action is irreversible and will remove all your data.

default.question: How do I download my data?
default.answer: You can request a backup of your data from the 'Danger Zone' section in profile settings. We'll prepare a file containing all your personal information.

Random chat pairs you with someone new for a real-time conversation. No feeds, no endless scrolling — just a hello and whatever comes next.

fields.label: Chat FAQ — title
fields.default: Questions people ask before they start

default.question: Do I need an account to start?
default.answer: You can jump in quickly. Some features may ask you to sign in so we can keep matching safe and fair.

default.question: Is random chat free?
default.answer: Yes — you can start for free. Leave or skip whenever you want.

default.question: Can I stay anonymous?
default.answer: You control what you share. You do not have to show your real name or personal details.

default.question: What if someone makes me uncomfortable?
default.answer: Use skip immediately, then report. Reports are reviewed by people, not ignored.

default.question: Text or video — which should I pick?
default.answer: Choose text for a calmer start. Choose video when you want a real-time face-to-face chat.

default.question: Can I switch modes later?
default.answer: Absolutely. Come back here anytime and start a different kind of chat.
